source.name: lidl.gr product pages
source.scope: the price lidl.gr shows for its default region (Lidl prices can differ by region; offers are time-limited)
source.method: product pages listed in the product sitemap advertised by robots.txt; only /p/ (allowed); 1 request at a time >=1.5 s apart; schema.org Product JSON-LD gtin13 + the single EUR offer price; pages with no barcode or more than one price skipped
source.terms: Imprint https://www.lidl-hellas.gr/c/imprint-lidl-website/s10100556 and the legal-compliance page (read 31 Oct 2026): no website terms of use and no clause on automated reading or quoting of prices found. (lidlhouse.gr, a separate Lidl site, has terms forbidding commercial use without written consent; they do not cover lidl.gr.)
